note: The tournament ring's view (2026-10-19): the plaza's midground V1 view (withNativeCityMidground(NATIVE_CITY_WORLD).views.V1) without its ground — projection, actor height, presentation and bounds only. The arena and the bracket's headless bouts stand their fighters on a fixed straight line with no ground test, so they need no walkable polygons; reading this instead of the whole world keeps the village's world data (gzip ~2 MB) off the arena's direct link. test/city-tournament-bout.test.ts keeps it equal to the computed view.
